description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class ResourcesNotModifiableException used in Eclipse Ditto for handling policy resource modification permission errors. It includes builder methods, JSON parsing capabilities, and is tightly coupled with the 'Policies' aspect of the project.

classes.name: ResourcesNotModifiableException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that resources of a policy entry could not be modified due to insufficient permissions.
